name: Planar Gnome
body:
Note Generally more powerful than their Material Plane counterparts, this humanoid variant are more likely be encountered as NPCs but may occasionally be allowed as player characters for high-powered campaigns.

Planar gnomes are known as inveterate pranksters. They use their change shape ability to spy, get into tight places, and generally cause mischief.

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Con, +2 Int, +2 Cha, –2 Wis. This trait alters ability scores.
Languages You begin play speaking Celestial and Gnome. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Goblin, Infernal, and Sylvan. This trait alters languages.
Change Shape (Su) You have the ability to assume the form of one specific type of animal of Small or Tiny size—typically a small mammal like a badger, bat, beaver, hedgehog, otter, or weasel. You can change to this form and back again once per day, plus one additional time per day for every 3 character levels you possess. Changing into your animal form or back is a full-round action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Your appearance is static: you will always have the same, recognizable features each time you assume your animal form. Changing into this form works as beast shape II, except that you always take the form of the same, specific animal and can maintain this form indefinitely. In animal form, you are effectively disguised as an animal, gaining a +10 bonus on Disguise checks to appear as such. This trait replaces defensive training, hatred, and keen senses.

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
